chat.title: Ask AGRI ONE
chat.noFarm: Add a farm first so the assistant can answer about it.
chat.loadError: Couldn't reach the assistant. Please try again.
chat.speechUnsupported: This browser can't listen for speech. You can still type your question.
chat.ttsUnavailable: This device has no {{language}} voice installed, so answers are shown as text only.
chat.helpTitle: I can answer using your own farm data.
chat.helpBody:
Try asking about:
• today's weather or the forecast
• the market price for one of your crops
• government schemes that match your records
• what your last crop scan said
• your soil test record
• your farm details
• a summary of what needs attention

recognitionError.no-speech: I didn't catch that. Please try again or type your question.
recognitionError.not-allowed: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.

recognitionError.unsupported: This browser can't listen for speech. Please type your question.
recognitionError.unknown: Speech recognition stopped. Please try again or type your question.

pestActivity.noTreatmentAdvice: AGRI ONE does not give treatment advice and does not recommend any chemical. For what to do about a pest, speak to your local agricultural officer or use the official sources below.
